title: An Outcome Analysis of Primary Membranous Nephropathy
official: An Observational, Longitudinal Study to Describe the Outcome, and Outcome Predictors, of Patients With Primary Membranous Nephropathy, and the Nephrotic Syndrome Treated With Rituximab, or Other Monoclonal Antibodies
summary:
This is an observational study intended to track the course of the primary membranous nephropathy disease in real-world clinical practice.

The study will primarily assess the long-term outcomes of patients with primary membranous nephropathy in the context of advances in treatment options.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults (≥18 years old) on the day of signing informed consent.
* Diagnosis of primary membranous nephropathy
* Nephrotic syndrome (proteinuria \>3.5 g/24 hours)
* Written informed consent to the use of recorded data for research purposes.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Legal incapacity or limited legal capacity.
* Any contraindication to treatment with rituximab or other monoclonal antibody
